The '''Exodo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Exodo II]].
